title: Proteins Without Tools: Folding and Binding Physics in Frontier Reasoning Models
plm_baselines: ESMFold-2 -> SaProt 650M & ESM-2 650M (Task 5 monomer alanine scan)
Boltz-2 -> StaB-ddG (zero SKEMPI training) & ESM-2 650M (Task 6 interface alanine scan)
code_and_data_released: Public GitHub repository with all 582 targets, anti-cheat/leakage pytest suite, and JSON result reports across all 8 tasks.

methods.datasets: 582 datapoints across 8 tasks: T1 forward folding (100 PDBs across 5 novelty strata), T2 inverse folding (same 100 stripped CA-only UNK backbones), T3 remote homology (120 SCOPe pairs across 3 difficulty rungs + decoys), T4 CAFA-6 function (120 UniProt entries in 2x3 pre/post-May-2026 x NK/LK/PK), T5 monomer alanine scan (52 panels x 18 = 936 mutations incl. 12 post-cutoff MaveDB & 24 de novo), T6 interface alanine scan (38 complexes: 31 pre-2026 PDB, 7 unseen/post-2026), T7 de novo & motif design (40 targets), T8 closed-loop AF2 binder design (12 epitopes x 16 shots).
methods.evaluation_protocol: Tasks 1-7 strictly forbid tools, code execution, databases, alignments, and predictors (--thinking-budget 4096). All 582 prompts strip PDB IDs, gene names, organism labels, and MSAs, checked by automated leakage tests. Task 8 runs 16-shot closed-loop AF2 feedback.
methods.controls_included: Pre- vs post-May-2026 cutoffs across Tasks 1/2/4/6/8, TM-score novelty stratification, same-AA neutral decoy pairing in T5/T6 (holding 1D AA-lookup win rate to 50.0% and AA-demeaned rho to 0.000), CAFA-6 Post-NK blind cell, and 5-gate anti-cheat design hygiene.
methods.compute_and_tools: Uniform 4096 thinking budget, zero tools on Tasks 1-7; Task 8 compares 16-shot closed-loop AF2 LLMs vs 16 open-loop BoltzGen samples.
methods.metrics: TM-score, scTM, AUROC & Recall@10%FPR, IA-weighted wFmax, Spearman rho, NDCG@5, Same-AA win rate, AA-demeaned rho, 4/5-gate design pass rate, Hit@16.
methods.wet_lab_protocol: None (computational evaluation on experimental ground truth for T3-T6 and refolding oracles for T1/T2/T7/T8).

key_results.benchmark: Tasks 1 & 2: 100 PDB monomers across 5 novelty strata (no tools, no IDs)
key_results.llm_model: GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6.2 Astra (think 4096, zero tools)
key_results.llm_score: Forward folding: all 3 models < 0.50 TM; Inverse folding: 0.43-0.46 scTM
key_results.baseline_score: ESMFold-2 0.8853 TM (0.8240 on struct_novel); ProteinMPNN 0.88-0.94 scTM
key_results.notes: Crucial tool-free counterpoint to OpenAI's GPT-6 preprint: stripping code execution, IDs, and AFDB relaxation artifacts drops GPT-6.2 inverse folding to 0.43-0.46 scTM vs ProteinMPNN 0.88-0.94.

key_results.benchmark: Task 3: 120 SCOPe 2.08 pairs (seq-easy, Foldseek 9-14% ID, deep twilight 8-16% ID, decoys)
key_results.llm_model: GPT-6.2 Astra / GPT-6.2 Sol / GPT-6.1 Sol
key_results.notes: Impressive win over ESM-2 650M on every rung, though SCOPe 2.08 sequences predate GPT-6 training cutoffs so pretraining exposure to SCOPe families cannot be fully excluded.

key_results.benchmark: Task 4: CAFA-6 function prediction (Post-NK blind cell, May-Oct 2026, n=20)
key_results.baseline_score: Pre-NK 0.5497 -> Post-NK 0.4521 (beats all LLMs by ~0.07-0.08 on blind Post-NK)
key_results.notes: Clean temporal-leakage demonstration: GPT-6.2 Astra beats NetGO 4.0 pre-cutoff (0.597 vs 0.550) but collapses -0.224 below NetGO 4.0 (0.373 vs 0.452) on truly unseen Post-NK proteins.

key_results.benchmark: Tasks 5 & 6: Monomer (52 panels) & Interface (38 complexes) alanine scanning with same-AA decoys
key_results.metric: Spearman rho / Same-AA win / AA-demeaned rho
key_results.llm_score: T5 overall: rho 0.494 (AA-demeaned 0.215, same-AA win 58.1%); T5 post-cutoff MaveDB (n=12): rho 0.144; T6 interface: pre-2026 rho 0.515 (demeaned 0.436) -> unseen/post-2026 (n=7) rho 0.163 (demeaned -0.038)
key_results.baseline_score: T5 SaProt: overall rho 0.478 (AA-demeaned 0.461, same-AA win 70.7%), post-cutoff MaveDB rho 0.328; T6 ESM-2 on unseen/post-2026: rho 0.159 (AA-demeaned 0.336, same-AA win 63.7%)
key_results.notes: Same-AA decoy controls expose the mechanism: GPT-6.2 scores high overall on T5 mainly via 1D residue-type priors (AA-demeaned rho 0.215 vs SaProt 0.461) and collapses on unseen/post-2026 interfaces (AA-demeaned -0.038 vs pre-2026 +0.436).

key_results.benchmark: Tasks 7 (40 fold/motif designs, zero tools) & 8 (12 epitopes x 16 AF2 closed-loop shots)
key_results.llm_model: GPT-6.1 Sol, GPT-6.2 Sol, GPT-6.2 Astra
key_results.llm_score: T7: 0.0% across all 3 models (fold TM>=0.50: 0.0%); T8: 0.0% Hit@16 across all 3 models (best ipTM 0.125-0.262)
key_results.baseline_score: T7: 5.0% 4-gate pass (fold TM>=0.50: 100%, motif<=1A: 62.5%); T8: BoltzGen 8.33% Hit@16 (mean traj 0.542 vs LLM 0.34-0.43)
key_results.notes: Shows that without Python geometry scripts and SolubleMPNN, GPT-6.2 fails every single de novo fold/motif design and 16-shot AF2 binder campaign under strict anti-cheat gates.

temporal_cutoff.evidence: Explicit pre- vs post-May-2026 stratification across Tasks 1, 2, 4, 5, 6, and 8 directly exposes memorization drops (CAFA-6 Post-NK -0.224; T6 unseen interfaces 0.515 -> 0.163); note T3 SCOPe 2.08 and T5 MegaScale de novo predate May 2026.

homology_overlap.evidence: Groups T1/T2 targets into 5 TM-score novelty strata (incl. 18 struct_novel TM < 0.53 and 28 de novo) and isolates twilight-zone homology in T3.

cross_modal_literature_recall.evidence: Strips PDB IDs, gene names, organism labels, and MSAs across all 582 prompts, verified by automated pytest anti-cheat/leakage checks; flags LK/PK literature persistence in T4.

preprocessing_artifacts.evidence: Same-AA neutral decoys cleanly separate 1D residue priors from 3D context; 5-gate hygiene blocks repeat-rod cheating in T7; minor T6 parse failures (89.5-92.1% parse ok) transparently logged.

downstream_oracle_filtering.evidence: Tasks 1-7 use zero external tools/oracles during generation; Task 8 explicitly tests 16-shot AF2 closed-loop feedback and still observes 0% Hit@16.

compute_and_tool_asymmetry.evidence: Uniform 4096 thinking budget and zero tools on Tasks 1-7 across all 3 GPT-6 models; Task 8 actually favors LLMs (closed-loop AF2 vs open-loop BoltzGen) yet LLMs still score 0%.

baseline_fairness.evidence: Strong dedicated specialist baselines on every task (ESMFold-2, ProteinMPNN, ESM-2 650M, NetGO 4.0, SaProt 650M, zero-SKEMPI StaB-ddG, RFdiffusion3+ProteinMPNN, BoltzGen).

data_and_wetlab_transparency.evidence: All 582 targets, prompts, anti-cheat tests, and JSON result reports are public on GitHub (caveat: single inference run n=1, small post-cutoff subgroups n=7 in T6 / n=20 in T4 Post-NK, and computational only).

takeaway: Across 582 identifier-stripped, cutoff-stratified targets without tools, GPT-6.2 models fail forward folding (<0.50 TM), inverse folding (0.43-0.46 scTM vs ProteinMPNN 0.88-0.94), de novo design (0%), and closed-loop binder design (0%), and collapse on post-cutoff CAFA-6 function (-0.224) and unseen interface scans (AA-demeaned rho -0.038). Same-AA decoy controls show their monomer alanine ranking relies heavily on 1D amino-acid priors rather than 3D physics, while they beat ESM-2 650M on SCOPe twilight-zone homology (0.893 vs 0.756 AUROC).
